newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia wins $80 mln China GSM expansion.
newsitem.headline: Nokia wins $80 mln China GSM expansion.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Thursday it signed a contract with Chinese Fujian Post and Telecomunications Administration to expand a GSM network in the Fujian province.
"The value of the contract is over $80 million," Nokia said.
The parties signed "a major expansion contract which will bring increased capacity, enhanced coverage as well as leading edge technology into Fujian province," it said.
Nokia will deliver an expansion of subscriber capacity for digital GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) and also "the first commercially available Chinese Short Message Service," it said.

Deliveries will begin at the end of 1997 and the expansion is scheduled to come on stream in the autumn of 1997. After the expansion, the GSM network will have capacity for 650,000 subscribers, Nokia said.
